title: Reconstruction Unit Price List: Labor, Install, Finish and Site Rates by Agreement
content:
These are the company's own unit rates for Reconstruction work, in US dollars, by agreement. Labor rates apply to change order and time-and-material work.

## Labor and wall rates

| Agreement | Finish carpenter, per hour | Painter, per hour | Drywall hang, tape, finish (smooth), per sq ft | Seal and two coats of paint, per sq ft of surface | Batt insulation install, per sq ft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 72.40 | 58.90 | 2.94 | 1.18 | 1.06 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 72.40 | 58.90 | 2.94 | 1.18 | 1.06 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 72.40 | 58.90 | 2.88 | 1.14 | 1.02 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 69.80 | 56.80 | 2.79 | 1.09 | 0.98 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 70.10 | 57.20 | 2.86 | 1.12 | 1.02 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 78.60 | 64.40 | 3.12 | 1.26 | 1.14 |

## Trim, flooring and cabinet install rates (material excluded)

| Agreement | Baseboard install, caulk and paint, per linear ft | Carpet and pad install, per sq ft | Luxury vinyl plank install, per sq ft | Ceramic or porcelain tile install, per sq ft | Base or wall cabinet install, per linear ft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 4.85 | 1.42 | 2.65 | 9.40 | 64.50 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 4.85 | 1.42 | 2.65 | 9.40 | 64.50 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 4.72 | 1.38 | 2.58 | 9.15 | 62.80 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 4.58 | 1.33 | 2.49 | 8.85 | 60.70 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 4.66 | 1.36 | 2.55 | 9.05 | 61.90 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 5.20 | 1.55 | 2.88 | 10.25 | 69.30 |

Carpet, vinyl plank and tile rates exclude the flooring material; the cabinet rate excludes the cabinets.

## Site rates

| Agreement | Roll-off dumpster, per placement | Post-construction final cleaning, per contract |
|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 585.00 | 0.00 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 585.00 | 285.00 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 585.00 | 485.00 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 545.00 | 875.00 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 585.00 | 225.00 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 615.00 | 0.00 |

## Units at a glance

Drywall, paint, insulation, carpet, vinyl plank and tile are priced by the square foot; baseboard and cabinet install by the linear foot; carpenter and painter labor by the hour; the dumpster by the placement; final cleaning by the contract. Hypothetical illustration of a unit rate at work: an assumed 130 square feet at an assumed $2.00 per square foot is $260.00.
